output.title: The People Who Went Home
output.excerpt: The line for winter coats gets shorter at both ends. At the front, a volunteer kneels to turn back the cuffs of a green parka. The child gives it the solemn test children give a coat, raising both arms straight up. At the back, another child feels his mother take his hand. They have been in the…

summary: The People Who Went Home follows a boy who leaves a school coat giveaway empty-handed. It asks how people trying to do good can learn from those they never get to help.
